g.text: Me gusta mucho el duende.

font-style: italic; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: end; fill: #1f1f1e

g.text: Porta quel vestito con una certa sprezzatura.

font-style: italic; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: end; fill: #1f1f1e

g.text: Ela fazia cafuné no filho até ele dormir.

font-style: italic; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: end; fill: #1f1f1e

g.text: In der kleinen Hütte herrschte eine wunderbare Gemütlichkeit.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b6a66
font-style: italic; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: end; fill: #1f1f1e

g.text: Les retrouvailles avec mes cousins ont été très émouvantes.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b6a66
font-style: italic; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: end; fill: #1f1f1e

g.text: Se me olvidó el paraguas en el tren.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b6a66
font-style: italic; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: end; fill: #1f1f1e

g.text: La película es aburrida, y yo estoy aburrido.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b6a66
font-style: italic; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: end; fill: #1f1f1e

g.text: Il me faut encore une heure pour finir.

font-style: italic; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: end; fill: #1f1f1e

g.text: Comprei o livro para lermos juntos.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b6a66
font-style: italic; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: end; fill: #1f1f1e

g.text: No te creo, me estás tomando el pelo.

font-style: italic; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: end; fill: #1f1f1e

g.text: Domani hai l'esame? In bocca al lupo!

font-style: italic; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: end; fill: #1f1f1e

g.text: Depuis qu'il pleut, j'ai le cafard.

font-style: italic; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: end; fill: #1f1f1e

g.text: Hast du Tomaten auf den Augen? Die Ampel ist rot!

font-style: italic; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: end; fill: #1f1f1e

font-style: italic; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: end; fill: #1f1f1e

font-style: italic; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: end; fill: #1f1f1e

font-style: italic; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: end; fill: #1f1f1e
